# Unit: Intro to Loops (single long document)

This pack is one long singular curriculum file used to stress end-to-end survival
of a single large source through extract → ingest → Layer 0 → route → Layer 1.

## Day 1 — What is a loop?

Students define a loop and give one classroom example. Warm-up, teach, practice.

## Day 2 — For vs while

Students choose between definite and indefinite loops for a task.

## Day 3 — Trace and debug

Students trace a loop on paper and find an off-by-one error.

## Day 4 — Nested loops (light)

Students read nested loop examples without writing their own yet.

## Day 5 — Mini project

Students write a short program that uses one loop to solve a classroom problem.

## Exit criteria

Every student can explain when a loop stops and show one working example.
